title: Tears of the Nether
description: Makes nether portals require crying obsidian to be lit. Makes ruined portals more valuable.
body:
Small mod I commisioned @nanodelta on Fiverr.

![Nether portal opening successfully](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/241eee9a487b3fdba9f75e94bb27b188956eecaf.png)
Regular portals won't work no more and will explode if you try to open one. Crying obsidian is now needed to lit one, and will be consumed on use. 

Makes exploration more rewarding. I added some particles to the whole "portal opening" part
